cost: C candidates and N sentences: pick O(C), report O(sum C + 1000N) time and O(N) bootstrap storage. Lambda sweep multiplies candidate cost by ten. repairs repeatedly scans nodes and matrix lookups; hand passes bounded by two. Parser, matrix initialization and induced-rule costs not bounded here. No timing gain claimed.

main.rs absurd-rerank calls run, which loads dev/test via items using annotator.annotate/annotate_kbest and absurd::judge. Scores pass through en::annotate::annotate_kbest from parser.parse_kbest (f32 promoted to f64), so negative infinity is admissible. run selects lambda on dev, report uses get for sentinel safety. inverse: Universe: bounded supplied candidate or Row inputs and one terminating call. Exclude observations forbidden by the scoped child invariants, conditional on each child's explicit premises. This is an inner absent-behavior model, not the complement of all Rust traces.
